results.title: Gauth Review 2026: Is This AI Homework Helper Worth It? | AgentFinder
results.content:
Gauth earns a 7/10 for nailing the core use case: turning a photo of a stuck-on problem into a clear, explained solution in seconds. The photo-first input, step-by-step explanations, and Assignment Solver for longer files make Gauth genuinely useful for day-to-day homework friction. Where Gauth falls short is pricing transparency and depth for students who need structured, long-term study support rather than one-off problem solving. If your need is "I'm stuck on this specific problem right now," Gauth is a strong, fast choice. If you need a structured study plan across a whole semester, pair it with or consider a dedicated platform like Study Genius AI instead.

Visit Gauth

Get weekly AI agent reviews in your inbox. Subscribe → [...] Rating: 7/10 Price: Freemium (free tier available; paid plans unlock unlimited or expanded solves, exact dollar figures not published as of October 2026) Best For: Students who want quick, specific homework answers with explanations, not a structured course Pros:

Cons:

Gauth's strongest case is speed: a student stuck on problem 7 at 9pm doesn't want a curriculum, they want the specific step they're missing, and that's exactly where Gauth is built to perform.

Visit Gauth [...] Gauth also isn't the right tool if transparent, published pricing matters to you before you commit. Students on a fixed budget who want to know exact costs upfront before testing a paid tier should confirm current rates directly rather than assuming.

Gauth's defining advantage against other AI study tools is photo-first input: where most competitors require typed text, Gauth reads a photo of a handwritten or printed problem directly. That single design choice changes who each tool is actually good for, and it's worth walking through Gauth's position against each major category of alternative in turn.
